title: How to calculate the monthly savings needed for a goal
task: Working backward from a target: what to put away each month to hit $X by a date.
keywords: how much to save per month

excel.note: A2=annual return, B2=years, C2=target. The 0 = starting from nothing; put current savings there instead if you have a head start.

explanation: PMT solves for the payment in any annuity — pointing its future-value argument at your target makes it answer the savings question: $20,000 in 5 years at 4% needs $301.66/month, noticeably less than the naive 20,000÷60 = $333 because growth does part of the work. At 0% return the two agree exactly. The minus sign flips PMT's pay-out convention into a positive deposit; a nonzero present-value argument accounts for money already saved.
